archetypes.name: dyn-stall-recovery
archetypes.rationale: Classifier and prompt changes alter Step 3 retry routing for checks-child-failed stalls.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the stall-recovery classifier changes for Step 3 and Step 6 checks-child-failed handling. Verify negative and unknown exit codes classify as checks-child-sigterm, positive exits preserve step-contract behavior, and only Step 3 receives checks-commit-route-retry. Check that prompt prose matches the implemented routing and does not imply a Step 6 retry path. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
